description: This file defines the 'Home' model class in the Goteo application. It manages the retrieval, validation, saving, deletion, and ordering of 'home' elements from the database, including methods for getting individual items, all items by node and type, and reordering items.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: Represents and manages 'home' elements within the Goteo application, providing methods for CRUD operations and ordering of items.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a 'home' element by item and node.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches all 'home' elements for a specific node and type, ordered by the 'order' field.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the 'Home' object ensuring required fields are set.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the 'Home' object to the database, handling inserts and updates.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a 'home' element based on item, node, and type.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Moves a 'home' element up in the order.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Moves a 'home' element down in the order.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Calculates the next order position for a new 'home' element.
